title: spCVAudit: Audit Spatial Cross-Validation Against Prediction Targets
description: R package that compares spatial cross-validation designs with a declared prediction target using nearest-neighbour distances and correlation contrasts. It supports weighted targets, explicit fold validation, selection among candidate schemes and Gaussian reference calculations. Companion software to "Nearest-neighbour distances and prediction error in spatial cross-validation" by Olatunji Johnson.
